description:
We are Team CodeRoasters, a group of enthusiastic students passionate about technology, coding, cybersecurity, and innovation. We enjoy solving real-world problems through creative ideas, teamwork, and practical solutions.

Our goal is to develop an innovative, user-friendly application that makes a positive impact. We believe in learning together, sharing ideas, and turning challenges into opportunities.

We welcome motivated team members with skills in programming, UI/UX design
